claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC plus EUCLIDEAN-SPECTRAL certificate promotes the flat-TT logarithm to a covariant spectral functional only through total curvature order two. On the source complement of a positive self-adjoint Laplace-type Weyl-bundle operator, its exact coefficient is -199/60 and its scale response is 199/30. The resolvent Frechet formula proves that changing the Laplace-type representative by a curvature-order-one self-adjoint endomorphism changes the sandwiched functional first at curvature order three. It therefore names the next missing data for this C2 carrier precisely: cubic and higher nonlocal curvature form factors. The independent R2 form factor, finite local C2 and R2 normalizations, kernel and boundary global data, local-Weyl completion, complete Gamma1 and Q1, and residual transfer remain open. The available Berger 34-to-26 contraction cannot be used as the compensator extension because its tau is a temporal diffeomorphism ghost on a different background, not the Wess-Zumino scalar compensator. This result is not Lorentzian, a restored renormalized-product theorem, a Hadamard state, Bridge 4, Bridge 5, or a particle statement.
